info.title: CLIMS API
info.description: Current Go/Fiber API for authentication, users, RBAC, orders, hotspot activation, inventory reporting, the condom catalogue, and health. All protected operations require a Bearer JWT and an active account. Permission codes are application permissions, not OAuth scopes. Limits are per backend process. Public signup never assigns a role.

servers.description: Same origin as the API and Swagger UI

get.description: Requires orders:read. Newest first. A hotspot manager (a user assigned a hotspot) sees that hotspot's reports and no others, whatever else their account holds. Anyone else sees the reports sent to their assigned district store or sent by them; orders:all_stores sees every report. `hot_spot_id` narrows the list to one hotspot.

post.summary: Report a hotspot stockout to its district's DCFPs
post.description: Requires orders:stockout and one of: the assigned hotspot (a hotspot manager may report for theirs only); orders:stockout_district and an active hotspot in the district you work in (your assigned store's district, or else your assigned subcounty's), which is how VHTs report for their district; or orders:all_stores. Records a stockout report for a condom category (`condom_category`: male, female or both), with an optional `message`, and notifies the people with orders:replenish at the store of the hotspot's district (its DCFPs) with an `order.stockout_reported` notification carrying the hotspot's name, place and contact, the category, the reporter and the message. The notification's resource is the hotspot. No order is created: ordering stock from NMS or JMS is the DCFP's separate step (`POST /api/v1/orders/warehouse-requests`). A hotspot without a district returns 422. The notification names Male, Female or Both (returned as `selection`) and no product or quantity. If the hotspot already has an open notification, the message is counted against it (200): its repeat_count rises and its selection widens when a new type is named (Male then Female is Both), and the history keeps both.

200.description: Counted against the hotspot's open notification

post.summary: Order stock from NMS or JMS
post.description: Requires orders:replenish and an assigned district store, which the order is for (orders:all_stores does not stand in for one: 403). Names the national warehouse (`warehouse_store_id`, NMS or JMS), the condom category (`condom_category`, male or female) and the `quantity`, with no product and no unit (sending `unit_of_measure_id` or `condom_id` returns 400). The warehouse chooses the product (`condom_id`) when it reviews the request, and the order takes that product's catalogue unit; until then `condom_id` and `unit_of_measure_id` are null. A store that is not a national warehouse returns 422 with `error.warehouse_store_id`. The order starts `queued` and the warehouse's staff with orders:process are notified (`order.replenishment_requested`). The warehouse then runs review, check-stock and dispatch, and the district runs receive (`POST /api/v1/orders/{id}/actions/{action}`).

post.summary: Send stock to a district store before it orders
post.description: Requires orders:process and an assigned store that is the sending warehouse (`warehouse_store_id`; orders:all_stores may send from either). Sends stock from NMS or JMS to a district store (`district_store_id`) that has not ordered it: one line per product, each with a `quantity` counted in the product's catalogue unit (sending `unit_of_measure_id` returns 400). Each line becomes an order created `dispatched`, marked `unrequested: true`, with `quantity_needed`, `quantity_approved` and `quantity_issued` all equal to the line's quantity. Only free stock goes: on hand less what district orders have reserved and less expired batches; more returns 409. Stock leaves first expiry first out, and a batch with under one month left needs `expiry_exception_reason` (422 with `error.expiry_exception_reason`). The `note` and transport apply to every line. A line that fails leaves the whole dispatch unsent, and the message starts `line N:`. A store that is not a national warehouse returns 422 with `error.warehouse_store_id`; a destination that is not a district store, 422 with `error.district_store_id`. The district's staff with orders:receive are notified (`order.shipment_dispatched`, saying it was sent without an order and quoting the note) and receive each order with `POST /api/v1/orders/{id}/actions/receive`. Such orders cannot be rejected, and the warehouse request report and the store summary's order counts leave them out; their quantity still counts as dispatched stock.

get.description: Requires orders:read and access to the order. Returns up to 50 events per page.

post.description: Applies to orders a DCFP placed with a warehouse (`POST /api/v1/orders/warehouse-requests`) and to warehouse requests linked to older alert orders. Warehouse staff with orders:process at the supplying store run review (queued or on_hold), check-stock (reviewed or on_hold: reserves the quantity and confirms, or holds the order until stock arrives) and dispatch (confirmed; optionally a smaller quantity_issued, releasing the rest, and the transport: waybill_number, vehicle_registration, driver_name, driver_phone). Until dispatch (queued, reviewed, on_hold or confirmed) they may instead reject the order with a reason: it becomes rejected, keeps rejection_reason, releases any reservation, and takes no further step (409). The district store then runs receive (orders:receive) with quantity_received; a mismatch needs discrepancy_note. orders:all_stores overrides store assignment. Generic pending orders and alert orders raised before stockouts became reports return 409. review, check-stock and dispatch accept an empty body; reject needs reason. review notifies the district of the approval (order.replenishment_approved), reject of the rejection (order.replenishment_rejected), and receive notifies the warehouse as well as the district. review names the product to send (condom_id, of the category requested), and the order takes that product's catalogue unit as its unit_of_measure_id (422 on error.condom_id when the product has none). review may set quantity_approved (at most the requested quantity); check-stock reserves it and dispatch issues at most it. Each step's quantity is kept in the order's history. check-stock does not count expired stock as available. dispatch takes batches first expiry first out, never takes expired batches (409 when unexpired stock is short), and needs expiry_exception_reason for a batch with under one month left (422). receive puts the counted quantity into the batches the warehouse shipped; a shortfall comes off the latest-expiring batch and a surplus goes to an unknown-expiry batch.

get.description: Requires orders:read. Returns newest orders first for the requesting or supplying store, assigned hotspot, or assigned rider. Add orders:all_stores for cross-store access.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by order_status, e.g. on_hold or rejected.

get.description: Requires orders:read. An order is visible to either store or users with orders:all_stores.

post.description: Creates an active account with the default registered user role, which starts with no permissions. Role and status fields are rejected. Limited to 10 requests per IP per minute. Email addresses, usernames and phone numbers must each be unused: a taken value returns 409 naming the field. Emails and usernames are compared case-insensitively and phone numbers by their digits, so 0772 123456 and +256772123456 conflict.

Sign in with an email address, username or phone number in `login`, and the password. Each identifier belongs to one account. Email addresses are tried first; if one account's username equals another's phone number and the password opens both, the response is 409 and the user signs in with their email address. Wrong credentials return 401 without saying which part was wrong. Returns a 24-hour HS256 JWT and the current account profile. Limited to 10 failed attempts per IP per minute. Successful requests do not consume the limit.

get.description: Any active account can read its own profile, including accounts with no assigned role. Status and permissions are reloaded from PostgreSQL.
List users Requires all permissions: users:read.

post.description: Creates an account with one or more existing roles. Requires users:create and roles:assign. Email addresses, usernames and phone numbers must each be unused: a taken value returns 409 naming the field. Emails and usernames are compared case-insensitively and phone numbers by their digits, so 0772 123456 and +256772123456 conflict.

get.summary: List the field users in your district
get.description: The VHT, hotspot manager and delivery agent accounts in the caller's district, newest first. The caller's district is their district store's, or else their subcounty's; a caller with neither gets 403. Requires all permissions: users:district_read.

post.summary: Create a field user in your district
post.description: For district focal persons: creates a VHT, hotspot manager or delivery agent account in the caller's own district, and no other role. A VHT needs subcounty_id, a subcounty in the district. A hotspot manager needs hot_spot_id, an active hotspot in the district; their subcounty is the hotspot's. A delivery agent is assigned the district store. Other assignment fields are ignored. Identifiers must be unused, as for createUser (409). A caller with no district gets 403. Requires all permissions: users:district_create.

get.description: Get a user Requires all permissions: users:read.

patch.description: Replaces all assigned roles with one existing CLIMS role. Changes affect the next protected request. Demoting the last active admin is rejected. Requires roles:assign.
Sets the store whose orders and stock the user works with: a DCFP's or delivery agent's district store, or a warehouse's national store. `null` clears it. Requires all permissions: users:update.

422.description: validation failed; `error.store_id` says what to fix.

patch.description: Disabled accounts cannot log in or use existing JWTs. Disabling the last active admin is rejected. Requires all permissions: users:update.

get.description: List roles and their permissions Requires all permissions: roles:read.

put.description: Replaces permissions atomically. Unknown codes roll back the update. The admin role is immutable. Changes affect the next protected request. Requires all permissions: roles:manage.

get.description: List supported permission codes Requires all permissions: roles:read.
Check process liveness
Pings PostgreSQL with a three-second timeout; returns 503 if the database is unreachable.

put.description: Replaces the complete set of role assignments. Duplicate role IDs are ignored. An empty array removes every assignment. Unknown roles return 422. Removing the last active admin is rejected. Requires roles:assign.

post.description: Ends the session that issued this token. The token is rejected from then on.

get.description: Lists your unexpired sessions, newest first, including revoked ones. `current` marks the session of this token.

delete.summary: Sign out one of your sessions
delete.description: Revokes one of your live sessions, for example a lost device. Returns 404 for another user's session or one that has already ended.

get.description: Requires users:read. Lists the user's unexpired sessions, including revoked ones.

delete.description: Requires users:update. Revokes every live session of the user. Disabling an account does this too.

post.description: Public; send the refresh token from login or the previous refresh. Returns a new access token and a new refresh token for the same session; the old refresh token stops working. Reusing an old refresh token more than 30 seconds after it was replaced is treated as theft and signs the session out. Returns 401 when the token is unknown, used, revoked or expired, and 403 when the account is disabled.

get.description: Requires inventory:read. Balances at the national warehouse and district stores per product and unit: on hand, reserved for confirmed orders, available, and incoming on dispatched replenishments. Users see their assigned store (a hotspot manager, their hotspot); orders:all_stores sees every store.

Requires inventory:read. The batches with stock at the stores the user may see (their assigned store; orders:all_stores sees every store), in the order dispatch takes them within each product and unit: earliest expiry first, unknown expiry last. band is the shelf life left in calendar months (expired, under_1_month, under_3_months, under_6_months, ok, or unknown without an expiry date), with days_remaining counted in Kampala time.

patch.description: Requires inventory:manage, at a store the user may manage (their assigned store; orders:all_stores any store). Corrects a batch's number, expiry date and quantity on hand, with a note saying why. One batch number has one expiry date at a store: a number already held under another expiry is refused (422), and one held under the same expiry joins this batch to it, so the batch returned can have another id. A new quantity corrects the registration itself when the batch is untouched and was registered once; otherwise it is an adjustment noted "Edited: <note>". A changed expiry date drops the batch's expiry alerts so the new date is announced. Stock may not fall below what open orders have reserved (409). Audited as inventory.batch_edited.

409.description: The batch holds no stock, or the change would leave less on hand than open orders have reserved.

delete.description: Requires inventory:manage, at a store the user may manage. Erases an untouched batch (see StockBatch.untouched) as if it was never registered: its stock comes off the store's balance, its ledger entries are removed (later entries' on_hand_after move to match), and so are its expiry alerts; a product left with no stock, history or batches at the store goes from its balances. Audited as inventory.batch_deleted. Once stock has left a batch it cannot be deleted (409): write off what is left with an adjustment (POST /api/v1/inventory/movements) instead.

409.description: Stock has left the batch, it holds no stock, or open orders have reserved what it holds.

get.description: Requires inventory:read. Per hotspot and product: quantity delivered and deliveries in the period, last delivery, quantity in transit, quantity still requested, held requests and the last stockout. Hotspot consumption is not recorded, so this reports supply rather than a count at the hotspot. District users see hotspots their store supplies. Users see their assigned store (a hotspot manager, their hotspot); orders:all_stores sees every store.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: First day of the period, YYYY-MM-DD.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Last day of the period, YYYY-MM-DD (included).

get.description: Requires inventory:read. Every change to a store's on-hand stock, newest first, with the balance after it. Order dispatch and receipt are recorded automatically and link their order. Users see their assigned store (a hotspot manager, their hotspot); orders:all_stores sees every store.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: First day of the period, YYYY-MM-DD.

parameters.name: to

post.summary: Record stock received or an adjustment
post.description: Requires inventory:manage and the store as your assigned store, or orders:all_stores. A receipt adds a positive quantity, for example a delivery from a supplier to the warehouse. An adjustment corrects stock after a count in either direction and needs a note. Stock cannot fall below what open orders have reserved (409). Stock is held in batches: a receipt or positive adjustment adds to the named batch, and a negative adjustment comes out of it (409 when the batch holds less).

Requires inventory:manage and the store as your assigned store, or orders:all_stores. Records every batch a delivery brought as a receipt into that batch, in one transaction: all lines are saved or none. Each line needs a batch_number and an expiry_date after today (Uganda's date). The same batch may appear on several lines with the same expiry date; a batch number given two expiry dates, or already held at the store under another expiry date, is refused (422). A message about one line starts with its number, e.g. "line 2: ".

get.description: Requires inventory:read and orders:all_stores. Per product and unit: warehouse and district stock on hand and available, stock in transit, quantity delivered to hotspots in the period, and open and held hotspot requests.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: First day of the period, YYYY-MM-DD.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Last day of the period, YYYY-MM-DD (included).

get.summary: One store's stock at a glance
get.description: Requires inventory:read and the store as your assigned store, or orders:all_stores. Per product and unit: stock on hand, reserved, expired, expiring within three months, held without an expiry date, usable (on hand less reserved and expired) and the next expiry date, as of now; received, dispatched and written off in the period; and dispatched in the last 90 days, for stock cover. For orders district stores placed with the store: how many are open at each step now, and how many were dispatched, rejected, dispatched in full and received short in the period, the districts supplied and the median days from order to dispatch.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: First day of the period, YYYY-MM-DD.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Last day of the period, YYYY-MM-DD (included).

get.description: Lists regions by name.
Lists districts by name, optionally filtered by region_id.
Stock-holding points: the national warehouses first, then district stores by name. Any active user may read them. `data` is always an array.
Lists subcounties by name for the required district_id.

Requires hotspots:read. VHTs (hotspots:submit) see hotspots they submitted; with hotspots:read_district they also see the active hotspots in the district they work in (assigned store's district, or else assigned subcounty's); DCFPs (hotspots:activate) see hotspots in the district of their assigned store; hotspots:all_districts sees every hotspot. Most recently updated first; comments count as updates. Filters narrow the hotspots you can already see; use review_status=submitted for the DCFP review queue. With hotspots:all_districts, submitted_by_id and district_id work nationally.

post.description: Requires hotspots:submit. The hotspot starts inactive with review status submitted, and notifies the district's DCFPs.

get.description: Deprecated: use GET /api/v1/notifications, which carries every hotspot notification with read state. This endpoint is removed once the web and mobile clients have switched. Requires hotspots:read. Events addressed to the user and, with hotspots:activate, to their district; hotspots:all_districts sees every addressed event. Newest first.

Requires hotspots:read. VHTs (hotspots:submit) see hotspots they submitted; with hotspots:read_district they also see the active hotspots in the district they work in (assigned store's district, or else assigned subcounty's); DCFPs (hotspots:activate) see hotspots in the district of their assigned store; hotspots:all_districts sees every hotspot. Includes the comment thread.

put.description: Requires hotspots:submit. Only the submitter can edit, and only while the hotspot is inactive. A changed contact person is added as the current contact. A deactivated hotspot cannot move to another district (409). Editing a rejected hotspot resubmits it with review status submitted. Notifies the district.

get.description: Requires hotspots:read. VHTs (hotspots:submit) see hotspots they submitted; DCFPs (hotspots:activate) see hotspots in the district of their assigned store; hotspots:all_districts sees every hotspot. Oldest first.

post.description: Requires hotspots:read. VHTs (hotspots:submit) see hotspots they submitted; DCFPs (hotspots:activate) see hotspots in the district of their assigned store; hotspots:all_districts sees every hotspot. A comment from the submitter notifies the district; any other comment notifies the submitter. The status does not change. District read access (hotspots:read_district) does not open a hotspot's thread.

Requires hotspots:activate. Applies to a submitted or deactivated hotspot; a rejected one must be resubmitted first. Only for hotspots in the district of the DCFP's assigned store unless they have hotspots:all_districts. The comment is required and recorded with the decision. Notifies the submitter.

Requires hotspots:activate. Applies to an active hotspot and sets review status deactivated. Only for hotspots in the district of the DCFP's assigned store unless they have hotspots:all_districts. The comment is required and recorded with the decision. Notifies the submitter.

Requires hotspots:activate. Applies to a submitted hotspot and sets review status rejected; the hotspot stays inactive. The VHT can edit it to resubmit. Only for hotspots in the district of the DCFP's assigned store unless they have hotspots:all_districts. The comment is required and recorded with the decision. Notifies the submitter.

get.description: Any signed-in user; covers only notifications addressed to them. Newest first. With unread=true, only unread notifications.
Any signed-in user; covers only notifications addressed to them. For the notification badge.

post.description: Any signed-in user; covers only notifications addressed to them. Returns how many were unread.

post.summary: Register this phone for push notifications
post.description: Any signed-in user. Records the device's Firebase Cloud Messaging token (`token`, the app's native push token) for the session that makes the request, so the user's notifications whose type allows push also arrive as pushes. Signing out or revoking the session stops them. A token registered before moves to the new user and session, and the session's previous token is forgotten; repeating the call changes nothing. When the server has no Firebase credentials the device is still recorded and no pushes are sent.
Any signed-in user; covers only notifications addressed to them. Marking an already read notification changes nothing. Returns 404 for a notification not addressed to you.

get.summary: Get a stockout notification with its deliveries and history
get.description: Requires orders:read, with the same visibility as the list; or orders:stockout, with which a reporter without orders:read (such as a VHT) sees only the reports they sent or about their own hotspot (404 otherwise). Shows the deliveries, per-line acknowledgements and every event behind the notification's status.

post.summary: Record a district delivery to the hotspot
post.description: Requires orders:supply_hotspots and the notification's district store as your assigned store, or orders:all_stores. Each line is a product of a selected type in its catalogue unit, converted to pieces; it comes out of the store's available stock (409 when too little) and is written to the inventory ledger as a hotspot_delivery. The hotspot's manager accounts are notified. A fulfilled or rejected notification refuses deliveries (409). Lines are taken first expiry first out; expired batches are never delivered, and a batch with under one month left needs expiry_exception_reason. Name a delivery agent with rider_id to have them carry it; they see it in GET /orders/deliveries.

200.description: A retried send matched an existing delivery

post.description: Requires orders:supply_hotspots and the request's district store as your assigned store, or orders:all_stores. Closes a request the district will not supply, with a reason, before any stock has gone to it: once a delivery is recorded the request can no longer be rejected (409), and a fulfilled request refuses it too (409). The hotspot's manager accounts and whoever sent the report are notified (order.stockout_rejected) with the reason. A rejected request takes no deliveries (409), and the hotspot's next stockout report opens a new request. Rejecting a rejected request again changes nothing and returns it (200).

post.summary: Acknowledge pieces received at the hotspot
post.description: Requires orders:stockout and the notification's hotspot as your assigned hotspot, or orders:deliver as the delivery agent named for the delivery each line belongs to (when the hotspot's manager cannot confirm). District and national users cannot complete fulfilment; any other line is refused (403). Each line records the pieces actually received and who confirmed them. Sending a line's count again is accepted once; a different count for an acknowledged line returns 409, whoever recorded it. The notification is fulfilled when every selected type has a positive acknowledgement, and the district is notified, told when the delivery agent confirmed.

get.description: Notifications raised in the period, their fulfilment (manager acknowledgement of every selected type), fulfilment rate, product components, response time, deadline progress, the earlier backlog, overdue acknowledgements and a comparison by district, all calculated from source records on request. Requires reports:read. orders:all_stores sees every notification; others see their district store's, their hotspot's, the ones they sent and, with orders:stockout_district, the district they work in. Filters only narrow that. Without from and to, the period is the current review cycle to date. deadline_days and target_percent default to the saved settings in effect for the filtered district's store, else the user's store, else national, and the response shows them in settings; passing them overrides for ad hoc analysis.

get.description: Current stock at warehouses and district stores: physical, reserved, usable and in-transit quantities in units and pieces, whether the ledger reconciles, and months of stock from average outward issues over the last three complete months. get.summary: Batches in stock and their expiry
get.description: Each batch held at a store, earliest expiry first, with days remaining and its band. Requires reports:read. orders:all_stores sees every store; other users see their assigned store only.

get.summary: Near-expiry stock issued with an exception
get.description: Batches with under one month left that left a store in the period, with the reason, who authorised it and the rule version, newest first. Requires reports:read. orders:all_stores sees every store; other users see their assigned store only.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: First Kampala day of the period.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Last Kampala day of the period, included.

get.summary: Response settings in effect and their history
get.description: Requires reports:read. The review cycle, receipt deadline and on-time target in effect today for a store (store_id) or nationally, and every saved row for that scope. Other users may read their own store or the national settings.

parameters.name: store_id
parameters.description: One store; omitted for national settings.

post.summary: Save response settings from a date
post.description: Requires reports:configure. Adds a setting that applies from effective_from (today or later), recording who set it and why; earlier rows are kept, so earlier reports stay reproducible. A user sets their assigned store's targets only; national targets and other stores need orders:all_stores.

get.summary: HMIS 105 condom figures, prepared but not submitted
get.description: Requires reports:read. 105-CT11 Female and 105-CT12 Male condoms in pieces for a month, from hotspot managers' acknowledged receipts dated by acknowledgement, by district and subcounty. This is operational evidence of supply, not condoms dispensed: the counting event, dispensing channel and subcounty reporting units await programme approval, and DHIS2 integration stays disabled. orders:all_stores sees every district; others see the district they work in.

parameters.name: month
parameters.description: YYYY-MM; defaults to the current month.

get.summary: Report measures per day, week or month
get.description: Requires reports:read. Notifications (by the day raised, followed as a cohort), district requests to national warehouses (by the day placed), district deliveries to hotspots and stock movements, per bucket over the period, with the same scope and filters as their reports, so a trend adds up to its report total. Weeks start on Monday and months on the 1st, in Kampala time. Without from, the period is the last six calendar months to date.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: First Kampala day; defaults to the first of the month five months before to.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Last Kampala day, included; defaults to today.

parameters.name: interval
parameters.description: day, week or month; defaults to days up to a month, weeks up to about a quarter, months beyond. At most 400 buckets.

get.summary: Hotspot coverage by region, district, venue type and dispenser
get.description: Requires reports:read. Every hotspot for national users (orders:all_stores or hotspots:all_districts), else those of the district the user works in; an account with no district gets 403. Counts by review status, dispenser and map position, and hotspots waiting on an open stockout request, with registrations per month over the last twelve months.

get.summary: Export a report's rows as calculated now
get.description: Requires reports:read. The same rows, filters and access rules as the report on screen (RN01, RN02), with the period, data update time, scope, product, rule version and definitions (RF15). Pass the report's own query parameters; unknown ones are rejected. CSV starts with that header block, then the column headers and rows, with Kampala times, and text that could run as a spreadsheet formula prefixed with an apostrophe. At most 50,000 rows.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: csv downloads a CSV file; json (the default) returns the table for the web's Excel export.

get.description: Requires reports:read. Newest first, without their figures. orders:all_stores sees every version; others see their store's.

post.description: Requires reports:approve and an assigned store, or orders:all_stores for a national version. Calculates the report now for the filters and saves the figures and rows unchanged, so they stay reproducible after later corrections (RN04).

get.summary: One approved version with its saved figures and rows
get.description: Requires reports:read. format=csv downloads the version's saved rows. Versions outside the user's scope return 404.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: csv downloads a CSV file; json (the default) returns the table for the web's Excel export.

post.description: Requires reports:approve, with the same scope as the version. Recalculates the report from the version's saved filters and saves it as a new version with the reason; the corrected version keeps its figures and becomes superseded. Only the latest version can be corrected (409).

get.description: Requires audit:read. Newest first. Filters combine; subject_type with subject_id matches an entry's target or any related record, which isolates one hotspot, order, district, store or user. Every search is itself recorded as audit.searched.

parameters.name: domain
parameters.description: Only actions in these domains (the part before the dot), separated by commas; for example user,role.

parameters.name: exclude_domain
parameters.description: Leave out actions in these domains, separated by commas; for example audit, to hide searches of the log.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: A date (2026-11-21, from its start in UTC) or an RFC 3339 time.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Exclusive; a date or an RFC 3339 time.

get.summary: List stores with assigned-user counts and physical stock
get.description: Requires inventory:read. Returns the assigned store, or every store with orders:all_stores, national warehouses first. An unassigned user receives an empty array. Counts all accounts assigned to each store. Physical stock includes reserved and expired quantities, grouped by category and unit; units are never added together. Stores without stock have on_hand: []. National stores have no district or region assignment.

200.description: Store overview list; data is always an array.

get.summary: List the delivery agents who may carry a delivery for a stockout
get.description: Requires orders:supply_hotspots and the notification's district store as your assigned store, or orders:all_stores. Lists active users with orders:deliver who work in the district of that store (their store's district, or else their subcounty's), by name.

get.summary: List the hotspot deliveries named for you as delivery agent
get.description: Requires orders:deliver. Returns only deliveries whose rider is the signed-in user, newest first, with the hotspot's details and contact, the lines, and whether the hotspot has confirmed receipt. Lists use limit (default 50, maximum 100) and offset.

bearerAuth.description: Paste the access token returned by POST /api/v1/auth/login (Swagger UI does this for you). Access tokens last 15 minutes; renew them with POST /api/v1/auth/refresh. Each token belongs to a login session; signing out or revoking the session rejects it at once. Role and permission changes take effect on the next protected request.

condom_category.description: The condom category the hotspot is out of; the district chooses what to send.

message.description: The message the DCFP reads in the notification; returned as comment.

OrderStockoutRequest.description: A stockout notification names a condom category and no product or quantity.

quantity_issued.description: dispatch only: a smaller quantity than ordered, releasing the rest of the reservation.

quantity_received.description: receive only (required): the quantity counted on arrival.

discrepancy_note.description: receive only: required when quantity_received differs from quantity_issued.

quantity_approved.description: review only: approve less than requested. Defaults to quantity_needed; check-stock reserves and dispatch issues against it.

expiry_exception_reason.description: dispatch only. Required when stock expiring within one calendar month would leave the store (first expiry first out). Recorded with who authorised it and the rule version.

condom_id.description: review only: the product the warehouse sends, an active product of the requested condom_category. Required at the first review of a request without a product (422 with error.condom_id); a held request may switch product at a new review.

reason.description: reject only (required): why the warehouse rejects the order. Trimmed; blank or missing returns 422 with error.reason. The district's DCFPs read it in their notification.

waybill_number.description: dispatch only, optional: the waybill or delivery note number. Trimmed; blank means not given. The district's dispatch notification includes it.

vehicle_registration.description: dispatch only, optional: the vehicle's registration, e.g. UAX 123B. Trimmed; blank means not given. The district's dispatch notification includes it.

driver_name.description: dispatch only, optional: the driver's name. Trimmed; blank means not given. The district's dispatch notification includes it.

driver_phone.description: dispatch only, optional: the driver's phone number. Trimmed; blank means not given. The district's dispatch notification includes it.

condom_id.description: The product. Null on a warehouse request until the warehouse chooses one at review.

quantity_needed.description: Null on an open stockout alert until the DCFP sends stock; then the quantity sent.

unit_of_measure_id.description: Null on a warehouse request until the warehouse chooses the product at review, which sets the product's catalogue unit; also null on an open alert order raised before stockouts became reports.

quantity_approved.description: What the warehouse approved at review, at most quantity_needed, which keeps the original request.

rejection_reason.description: Why the warehouse rejected the order; set only when order_status is rejected.

waybill_number.description: Transport recorded at dispatch, if given.

vehicle_registration.description: Transport recorded at dispatch, if given.

driver_name.description: Transport recorded at dispatch, if given.

driver_phone.description: Transport recorded at dispatch, if given.

unrequested.description: True for stock the warehouse sent without an order (POST /api/v1/orders/district-dispatches): created dispatched, received like any shipment, and left out of request statistics.

username.description: Trimmed before validation. Existing legacy usernames are not unique.

email.description: Trimmed, lowercased, and unique without regard to case.

password.description: At least 8 characters; at most 72 UTF-8 bytes (not just characters).

username.description: Trimmed before validation. Existing legacy usernames are not unique.

password.description: At least 8 characters; at most 72 UTF-8 bytes (not just characters).

login.description: Email address, username or phone number, each unique to one account. Emails and usernames are case-insensitive; phone numbers match in any format, e.g. 0772 123456 or +256772123456.

email.description: Older name for `login`, still accepted. Send one of the two.

password.description: At most 72 UTF-8 bytes. Login supports existing bcrypt passwords.

store_id.description: An existing store, or null to clear it.

permissions.description: Replaces the complete permission set; [] revokes all management permissions. The admin role cannot be changed.

email.description: Legacy accounts without an email return an empty string.

organisation_unit.description: Assigned organisation unit details, or null when unassigned.

hot_spot.description: Assigned hot spot details, or null when unassigned.

store.description: Assigned store details, or null when unassigned.

login_count.description: Successful logins since login counting began.

active_sessions.description: Devices currently signed in: live, unrevoked sessions.

NullableRole.description: First assigned role ordered by UUID. Null when the account has no assigned roles.

expires_in.description: Seconds until the access token expires (15 minutes, or sooner when the session ends first).

refresh_token.description: Single use. Exchange it at POST /api/v1/auth/refresh before the session expires; store it securely.

refresh_expires_in.description: Seconds until the session ends and a new login is required (30 days after login).

subcounty_id.description: Required for a VHT: a subcounty in your district.

hot_spot_id.description: Required for a hotspot manager: an active hotspot in your district.

last_seen_at.description: Updated at most once a minute.

refresh_expires_in.description: Seconds until the session ends and a new login is required (30 days after login).

incoming.description: Dispatched to this store by the warehouse and not yet received.

unit_of_measure_id.description: Null on the row for open alerts, which have no unit until the DCFP acts.

open_alerts.description: Stockout alerts not yet sent or still waiting for the warehouse.

quantity.description: Positive adds stock, negative removes it.

actor_id.description: Null for system entries such as opening balances.

batch_number.description: The batch a receipt or adjustment changed; null for order steps, which can span batches, and for stock without batch details.

quantity.description: Positive for a receipt; nonzero for an adjustment.

batch_number.description: The batch the stock is in. With expiry_date it names the batch; omitted, the stock is in the unknown-expiry batch.

expiry_date.description: The batch's expiry date. Unknown expiry is not counted as usable in reports.

unit_of_measure_id.description: Null on the row counting open stockout alerts, which have no unit yet.

Hotspot.description: Converted legacy hotspots can lack fields that the API requires for new submissions.

status.description: Only an active hotspot is in use.

review_status.description: The workflow step. Every value except active means status is inactive.

submitted, updated, resubmitted, commented, activated, deactivated or rejected.

name.description: Unique within the village, ignoring case and extra spaces.

subcounty_id.description: Must belong to the district, which must belong to the region.

contact_person_phone.description: 9 to 15 digits with an optional leading +; spaces, dashes and parentheses are removed.

comment.description: Optional; stored as the hotspot's first comment.

code.description: `jms` or `nms` for a national warehouse; the district's DHIS2 UID for a district store.

CatalogueRef.description: A linked brand or unit of measure.

Product.description: A condom product. Converted legacy products may have null category, type, brand, unit or pieces_per_unit; A complete product is required on creation, editing or activation. For units named Piece or Pieces (case-insensitive), pieces_per_unit may be omitted and is stored as 1; other units need a pack size.

pieces_per_unit.description: How many condoms one unit holds.

active.description: Inactive products are hidden from pickers and cannot be ordered.

in_use.description: Referenced by orders or stock records, so it can be deactivated but not deleted.

pieces_per_unit.description: Optional for a unit named Piece or Pieces (case-insensitive): omitted counts become 1 and other counts are rejected. Required for other units on creation; PATCH otherwise preserves an existing count.

pieces_per_unit.description: Optional for a unit named Piece or Pieces (case-insensitive): omitted counts become 1 and other counts are rejected. Required for other units on creation; PATCH otherwise preserves an existing count.

CatalogueLookup.description: A product type, a brand or a unit of measure.

active.description: Inactive types, brands and units cannot be newly chosen for a product.

in_use.description: Referenced by a product (or, for units, by orders or stock), so it can be deactivated but not deleted.

product_count.description: Products that use it, active or not.

name.description: Unique regardless of case. Surrounding spaces are trimmed.

marked.description: How many unread notifications were marked read.

resource_type.description: The kind of record the notification is about, for opening it.

actor_id.description: The user whose action caused the notification.

warehouse_store_id.description: A national store: NMS or JMS.

condom_category.description: The condom category requested; the warehouse chooses the product at review.

quantity.description: How many, counted in the catalogue unit of the product the warehouse chooses at review. The district names no unit.

district_store_id.description: The district store the stock goes to.

lines.description: One line per product; a product may appear on one line only.

note.description: The warehouse's word to the district, e.g. why the stock is sent. Stored as each order's comment.

expiry_exception_reason.description: Required when a batch with under one month left would go; recorded as an expiry exception.

waybill_number.description: Transport, each optional; blank counts as not given.

condom_id.description: An active product with a catalogue unit.

quantity.description: How many, in the product's catalogue unit.

hot_spot.description: The hotspot's current details, and its latest contact person.

condom_id.description: Set only for notifications sent by product.

district_store_id.description: The district store the report went to.

repeat_count.description: Messages repeated against this open notification.

fulfilled_at.description: When the last acknowledgement needed for every selected type was recorded.

rejected_at.description: When the district rejected the request instead of supplying it. A rejected request is closed.

rejected_by.description: The name of the person who rejected it.

rejection_reason.description: Why the district rejected the request; the hotspot reads it.

rider.description: The delivery agent carrying it, when the district named one.

unit_of_measure_id.description: Must be the product's catalogue unit, which is the default.

client_reference.description: Chosen by the client; a retried send with the same reference records the delivery once (200).

expiry_exception_reason.description: Required when stock expiring within one calendar month would leave the store (first expiry first out). Recorded with who authorised it and the rule version.

rider_id.description: Optional delivery agent carrying it: an active user with orders:deliver working in the hotspot's district (GET /orders/stockouts/{id}/riders). Anyone else is refused (422, error.rider_id). The agent is notified (order.delivery_assigned).

pieces.description: Pieces actually received; zero when nothing arrived.

acknowledgements_through.description: Acknowledgements recorded up to this time are included.

notifications_raised.description: Distinct notifications raised in the period; repeats are not counted again.

notifications_fulfilled.description: Raised in the period and fully acknowledged by data_updated_at.

notifications_rejected.description: Requests in the period the district rejected: closed without stock, neither fulfilled nor pending.

fulfilment_rate.description: Percentage to one decimal; null is Not applicable (no notifications).

component.description: With category: that type's part of each notification including it. A Both notification counts under each type, so the two components exceed unique notifications.

rate.description: Percentage to one decimal; null is Not applicable (no notifications).

median_hours.description: Median time from notification to the last acknowledgement needed, among fulfilled notifications.

on_time_rate.description: Percentage to one decimal; null is Not applicable (no notifications).

late_pending.description: Still open and past the deadline.

backlog.description: Open notifications raised before the period, kept apart from it.

acknowledgement_overdue.description: Quality issue: notifications with a delivery unacknowledged for longer than the deadline.

fulfilment_rate.description: Percentage to one decimal; null is Not applicable (no notifications).

acknowledged_pieces.description: Counted by the district on receipt.

quantity_fulfilment_rate.description: Acknowledged pieces divided by originally requested pieces.

fully_received.description: Received quantity at least the requested quantity.

pending.description: Still open: neither received by the district nor rejected by the warehouse.

rejected.description: Rejected by the warehouse before dispatch. Still counted as requested (and in the fulfilment rate), with no approved pieces.

unconverted.description: Quality issue: requests not in the product's catalogue unit, or for a product without pieces per unit, left out of the piece totals.

awaiting_unit.description: Requests naming only a category and a number; the warehouse picks the product, and its unit, at review. Left out of the piece totals until then; not a quality issue.

by_type.description: By condom type; id and name are male or female.

median_hours.description: Median time from request to district receipt, among received requests.

dispatches_without_request.description: Stock warehouses sent to districts in the period without a request (district dispatches); not part of the request totals or the fulfilment rate.

awaiting_receipt.description: Dispatches the district has not received yet.

usable.description: Physical less expired, unknown-expiry and reserved stock, at least zero.

in_transit.description: Dispatched to this store and not yet received.

reconciled.description: The inventory ledger adds up to the physical balance.

months_of_stock.description: Issue-based coverage: usable divided by average monthly outward issues. It does not measure consumption.

expired.description: In batches past their expiry date; blocked from issue.

unknown_expiry.description: In batches without an expiry date, needing review.

batches_reconciled.description: The store's batches add up to the physical balance.

stock_date.description: When the balances were read, separate from any reporting period.

coverage_window.description: The last three complete Kampala months.

expiry_tracked.description: True: stock is held in batches with expiry dates.

band.description: Shelf life left in calendar months. under_1_month (red) needs an exception to leave a store.

source.description: The store's own setting, the national one, or the draft default (monthly, 7 days, 80%).

store_id.description: The store the setting covers; null or omitted for national settings, which need orders:all_stores.

effective_from.description: Defaults to today; cannot be in the past.

acknowledgements.description: Delivery lines acknowledged with pieces in the month.

unacknowledged_lines.description: Quality issue: lines delivered in the month and not yet acknowledged; not counted.

integration_enabled.description: False: nothing is sent to DHIS2 until the programme authorises it.

filters.description: The filters with the period and targets resolved, so a recalculation covers the same period.

rows.description: The report's records keyed by column; null means not applicable or not recorded, 0 a recorded zero.

filters.description: The report's query parameters: from, to, category, district_id, hot_spot_id, deadline_days, target_percent, status, store_type, warehouse_store_id, store_id, band or month.

store_id.description: The approving user's store; null for national versions.

filters.description: The report's query parameters: from, to, category, district_id, hot_spot_id, deadline_days, target_percent, status, store_type, warehouse_store_id, store_id, band or month.

store_id.description: The approving user's store; null for national versions.

summary.description: The report's figures as shown on screen when approved; null for expiry exceptions.

filters.description: The report's query parameters: from, to, category, district_id, hot_spot_id, deadline_days, target_percent, status, store_type, warehouse_store_id, store_id, band or month.

name.description: The record's current name where the log can look it up: a user's username. Null for other records, or once the account is deleted.

actor.description: The acting user as they were when the entry was written.

system_actor.description: The automated job that acted, when no person did.

subjects.description: The target and the related records the entry concerns.

changes.description: Changed fields, before and after. Secrets are never recorded.

batch_number.description: Null for stock recorded without batch details.

days_remaining.description: Days from today (Kampala) to the expiry date; negative once expired; null without an expiry date.

untouched.description: Nothing has left the batch or come into it through an order: its stock is exactly what its own registrations and corrections add up to. Deleting it erases it as if it was never registered; editing the quantity of one registered once corrects that registration.

expiry_date.description: A past date is allowed: a correction can find the stock expired.

on_hand.description: The quantity the batch should hold. Delete the batch to remove all of it.

note.description: Why the batch is changing; kept in the audit log, and on the adjustment when the quantity change is one.
Where the delivery came from, e.g. the supplier and its delivery note number. Recorded on every line.

reserved.description: Held for orders approved with stock reserved.

expired.description: In batches past their expiry date; cannot be reserved or dispatched.

expiring.description: In batches with under three months left, not yet expired.

no_expiry.description: Held without an expiry date recorded.

usable.description: On hand less reserved and expired: what can still be reserved.

next_expiry.description: Earliest expiry date of an unexpired batch.

received.description: Stock registrations and warehouse order receipts in the period (receipt and order_receipt).

dispatched.description: Stock dispatched to district stores or hotspots in the period (dispatch and hotspot_delivery).

written_off.description: Taken away by adjustments in the period.

dispatched_90_days.description: Stock dispatched to district stores or hotspots in the 90 days to now, whatever the selected period.

waiting_for_stock.description: Open now: reviewed or on hold.

in_transit.description: Open now: dispatched, not yet received.

dispatched_in_full.description: Dispatched in the period with at least the quantity ordered.

districts_supplied.description: District stores dispatched to in the period.

received_short.description: Received in the period with less counted than dispatched.

median_days_to_dispatch.description: From order to dispatch, for orders dispatched in the period.

hot_spot.description: The hotspot's current details, and its latest contact person.

acknowledged.description: True once the hotspot's manager has confirmed every line.

RiderDelivery.description: A hotspot delivery named for the signed-in delivery agent.
